notes.title: Horrible Dream - publishing a page on Steam!
notes.content:
Dear friends, we are glad to present you our first game - Horrible Dream. We have been fruitfully developing it for a long time, so that you would like our product.

Our team works hard on every detail of the game to create an exciting and unforgettable gaming experience. Exciting adventures, fascinating puzzles and unique gameplay are waiting for you, which will make you plunge into the world of Horrible Dream.

[b]We also present to your attention our announcing trailer[/b]

[previewyoutube=7-H8XaHNnRI;full][/previewyoutube]

Stay tuned for our updates, because soon we will share with you more information about the release date and special pre-orders. Join our community to keep up to date with all the news and exclusive materials about the game. Thank you for your support, it is very important to us! We plan to release the game at the end of May this year.

[b]You will help us a lot if you add the game to the desired[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2959520/Horrible_Dream/
